notes.title: Hell Runner Spring Update
notes.notes:
Welcome To Spring Chapter


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251580/465060ea3791b7b8d399fc10330bf338681be98b.png

Changes

 New Chapter: Spring
 New Skill: Dash: Launch you in the direction you moving horizontally and reset jump count
 Adjusted Hookshot maximum distance: The maximum distance you can aim to start a Hookshot has been reduced by half. 
 Levels that use the Hookshot have been adjusted accordingly to the new Hookshot range
 Stomp changed. Now it works as toggle. Click to activate and click to deactivate earlier. 
 Wall Run modified. Now you have more horizontal movement and less vertical movement. 
 Wall Jump have kick in it. Push you toward opposite direction slighly
 Jumpers have directional push now. Stomp also increase directional power of jumpers
 Level selection lock image fixed
 Ledge detection improved


Demo Changes:

 Demo has been updated and now it have 2 level from spring as well alongside getting other updates.




Gameplay Summery of Spring Chapter:
https://youtu.be/Zvtbx7s6RqQ
Or Shorter Version
https://youtu.be/sB5UZcUjjds


Warning:


Majority of the platforms and objects in Spring Chapter are placeholder. They gonna be replaced soon

notes.title: Update Notes For Version 0.2.284
notes.notes:
News & Changes

 Ledge Climb added. You can now ledge climb on platforms rather than fall to your demise
 Wall Detection now also check diagonally. 


Ledge Climb Demonstration:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43251580/5230b34e88fdb348216f188b0ccc3b6271b0d58e.gif


Wall Dection Chance

 Old wall detection was only detect direct left and right. It was problem when player not keep wall on their almost exact right or left. Now it also have diagonal detection so it become much more forgiving on detecting wall run and wall jump.
